press_references.value: Ajman Bank signs agreement with Aurionpro to advance Islamic treasury systems validation

partnership_announcements.description: Ajman Bank has entered into a new partnership agreement with Aurionpro, via its Fenixys unit, to validate the bank’s Islamic Treasury Management System based on the MX.3 platform as part of its treasury transformation programme.

press_references.value: Ajman Bank signs strategic financing agreement with Lifepharma at Make It In The Emirates

partnership_announcements.description: Ajman Bank and LIFEPharma formed a strategic financing partnership to support LIFEPharma’s expansion into advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing and complex therapies under the Make it in the Emirates initiative.

press_references.value: Ajman Bank and Al Zorah announce strategic collaboration to enhance homeownership solutions in Ajman

partnership_announcements.description: Ajman Bank and Al Zorah Development Company signed an MoU for a strategic collaboration to provide Sharia-compliant property financing for residential developments in Al Zorah City, enhancing access to homeownership in Ajman.

press_references.value: Ajman Bank and Oracle Collaborate to Strengthen UAE’s Digital Banking Ecosystem

partnership_announcements.description: Ajman Bank announced a partnership with Oracle to run its next‑generation trade finance platform on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, migrating its new trade finance app to OCI to boost scalability, security, and efficiency, with further collaboration on cloud, data, and analytics use cases.

press_references.value: Ajman Bank collaborates with Accenture to accelerate digital transformation and enhance customer-centricity

partnership_announcements.description: Ajman Bank signed a collaboration with Accenture to drive its next phase of digital transformation, covering digital strategy, architecture, and a core-banking upgrade roadmap to enhance customer-centricity.

press_references.value: Ajman Bank, Franklin Templeton to launch Shariah-compliant funds in UAE

partnership_announcements.description: Ajman Bank announced a partnership with Franklin Templeton to offer select Luxembourg‑domiciled Shariah funds in the UAE, including Franklin Shariah Technology, Franklin Shariah Global Multi‑Asset Income, and Templeton Shariah Global Equity.

press_references.value: Ajman Bank and MENSA Technologies announce strategic alliance to transform WPS services in the UAE

partnership_announcements.description: Ajman Bank and MENSA Technologies have announced a strategic partnership to enhance Wage Protection System (WPS) services in the UAE, combining Islamic banking infrastructure with fintech payroll solutions to improve salary disbursement and financial inclusion.

press_references.value: Ajman Bank partners with Canon Middle East to implement sustainable print initiatives

partnership_announcements.description: Ajman Bank and Canon Middle East announced a new partnership to implement sustainable print initiatives, including a Climate Contribution Project to offset 25 tons of CO2 emissions from Canon print operations at the bank.

press_references.value: Ajman Bank partners with Yubi MENA to support business banking customers

partnership_announcements.description: Ajman Bank has announced a partnership with Yubi MENA to deliver SME trade working capital, supply chain finance, and other value-added services to business banking customers. The collaboration leverages Yubi's technology platform to enhance Ajman Bank's SME finance offerings and expand market penetration in the UAE and MENA region.

press_references.value: Ajman Bank partners with AAOIFI to certify the workforce in Shari’ah standards

partnership_announcements.description: Ajman Bank partners with AAOIFI to certify its workforce in Shari’ah standards through the CPSS program.

overview_description.description: Ajman Bank is a commercial bank that operates as a full-fledged Islamic bank, offering Shari’ah-compliant financial services. The bank provides a range of products including current and savings accounts, credit cards, personal and auto finance, home financing, and investment options like Islamic investment funds and Sukuk trading. Ajman Bank also offers digital banking services such as internet and mobile banking.
